idea-plugin.name: Turbo Log Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Place the caret on a variable, parameter, or field, run "Insert Log Statement", and get a real println (Kotlin) / System.out.println (Java) right after the enclosing statement -- with the class, method, and line number already baked in as literal text, so it works identically whether the surrounding code is static, instance, or top-level. Every inserted statement carries the same TCLC marker, so "Remove All Log Statements" can find and clean up every one it added, anywhere in the file, in one action -- never leaves debug prints behind by accident.

Ports a pattern that's genuinely popular elsewhere (VS Code's Turbo Console Log, ~2M installs) with no equivalent anywhere in JetBrains Marketplace -- confirmed by search before building, not assumed. Real Java AND Kotlin support, not just one language.

100% local -- no network call, no account, no telemetry. Every insertion is validated against an in-memory PSI copy before anything touches disk: if it can't be inserted safely, nothing is written, and you get an honest notification instead of broken code.

action.description: Inserts a print statement for the variable under the caret, with class/method/line already baked in as literal text
Removes every log statement this plugin has inserted in the current file
